acceptance: `go vet -tags acs ./acs/cycle334/` is clean and `go test -tags acs -count=1 ./acs/cycle334/` passes on main
The PR states the decision on a compile-only acs step in CI
fix: Port the predicate to the current Options (DefaultHours or UsageReset seam) keeping its intent, or retire it if a quotareset unit test pins the same behavior (name that test). Consider a CI step that only builds every acs package (`go vet -tags acs ./acs/...`) so a compile break is caught.
summary: On main 1db031993 (2026-10-26) `go vet -tags acs ./acs/cycle334/` fails: predicates_test.go:43:70 unknown field HoursFn in struct literal of type quotareset.Options. go/internal/quotareset/quotareset.go:23 now has Now, ResetAt, DefaultHours, BenchedUntil and UsageReset. Any `go vet -tags acs ./acs/...` or `go test -tags acs ./acs/...` sweep fails to build this package. No CI job builds acs/cycle* with the acs tag, so the break was not seen.
title: Archived predicate acs/cycle334 does not compile on main: quotareset.Options has no HoursFn field
